newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cbank sets 4-wk T-bill auction Wed at 16 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech cbank sets 4-wk T-bill auction Wed at 16 pct.

text.p: The Czech central bank set on Tuesday an auction offering five billion crowns in four-week finance ministry treasury bills on Wednesday, with maximum gross yield on bids limited to 16.0 percent.

The gross yield corresponds to a minimum bid of 987,706 crowns for the bills with a nominal value of one million crowns. In the previous auction of four-week T-bills last Thursday, gross yield was 16.2 percent.
